skill.displayName: OpenClaw 升级前影响评估工具
skill.summary: 深度分析 OpenClaw 版本更新对现有配置的影响，生成兼容性报告并精准备份受影响文件。Invoke when user asks to analyze OpenClaw updates, check upgrade compatibility, or backup configs before upgrading.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Skill renamed from openclaw-update-checker to openclaw-upgrade-assistant.
- Added 116 files, mainly introducing new dependencies (e.g., fs-extra and related modules).
- Removed 5 files, including guides and markdown reports (.gitignore, CLAWHUB-PUBLISH.md, etc.).
- No changes to user-facing features or usage—functionality and documentation remain consistent.
- Improved skill metadata to highlight the use case and invocation triggers.
